snippet.title: Pingbert's Snow Ride | Demo Available Now!
snippet.description:
**Slide, soar, and deliver!** 🐧❄️

Join Pingbert, a penguin mail carrier, in **Pingbert’s Snow Ride**! A fast-paced platformer where you'll slide down snowy slopes, soar through the air, uncover secrets, and deliver mail at high speed!

📬 **The Demo is NOW AVAILABLE on Steam!**

Playable on Windows and Linux, with Steam Deck support!

🎮 **Play it now:** https://store.steampowered.com/app/3336220/Pingberts_Snow_Ride/

💬 **Join our official Discord:** https://discord.com/invite/XWdxFGc6AD

🎵 Music composed by Victor Yeste: https://www.youtube.com/@victoryeste9628
